note: One short block on the book's first turns run: it states where the run starts, turns and lands, that each pass climbs a semitone, the vowels, and the feel to reach. The tempo is moves (50 to 80 bpm), the run written at 50.

exercise.title: A run with turns
exercise.why: A turn goes one note past where it is heading and comes back, so it trains your voice to change direction without losing the pitch.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the run: two chords set the key, and the mic starts with them. The run starts on Sol, turns up to La and back, and comes down to Do with one more turn round Mi on the way, four notes per beat. Each pass starts a semitone higher. Sing it on "ah", and change to "oo" as the passes climb.
Practice until each turn shows as separate steps in your line, and stop at the pass where it stops feeling easy.
